facts.fact: StackAdapt was named one of the 2022 Ad Age Best Places to Work, according to a press release dated January 24, 2022.
facts.quote: StackAdapt has been named one of the [2022 Ad Age Best Places to Work](https://adage.com/2022-best-places-to-work).

facts.fact: StackAdapt was ranked in the top 5 out of thousands of applicants as one of the best workplaces for employees, work-life balance, advancement and collaboration, per the vendor's announcement.
facts.quote: was [ranked top 5](https://adage.com/article/best-places-work/best-places-work-2022-stackadapt/2391171) out of thousands of applicants

facts.fact: The 2022 Ad Age Best Places to Work list included 50 companies.
To be eligible for the Ad Age Best Places to Work program, a company had to operate a facility with at least 15 employees working in the United States for at least one year.
facts.quote: operating a facility with at least 15 employees working in the United States for at least one year

facts.fact: The 2022 Ad Age Best Places to Work ranking combined a workplace policies evaluation with an employee survey, and Best Companies Group managed the process and determined the final rankings.
facts.quote: The first part consisted of evaluating each nominated company’s workplace policies, practices, philosophy, systems, and demographics. The second part consisted of an employee survey

facts.fact: Ad Age revealed the final 2022 Best Places to Work rankings in a special report published in January 2022.
facts.quote: revealed the final rankings in a special report published in January 2022.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's own description, it is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform where ad buyers plan, execute, and manage data-driven digital advertising campaigns across all devices, inventory and publisher partners.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the most exceptional digital marketers.
